title: Helper restart
note: 10 helper kills 75 s apart on the fixed Desktop (restart schedule resets after 60 s uptime) with en*-only published LAN addresses and the 1.5 s LAN-phase budget: recoveries 2.2-2.6 s (p95 2.6 s). Earlier runs: 31-35 s per restart when kills were 30 s apart (crash-loop backoff, schedule never reset; fixed) and 4.0-4.3 s before the address filter.
